Set the brave general straight. Stop the plot to seize the altar!

Join the isolated Sun Ce, and wipe out the enemy with a winning strategy!
Retake the stolen supply depot. Raise morale and launch a counterattack!

Save the captive princess. Stop the messengers calling for reinforcements!
Rescue Da Qiao quickly, then join forces to defeat the enemy!
A daring escape from enemy lines. More haste, less speed!

Sneak in and free Sun Jian, then reach the escape point as one!

[04Mitsuhide Akechi] is struggling! Send aid!
[04Mitsuhide Akechi] is in danger of defeat! Send aid at once!
Destroy the [02floodgates] and flood [02Fan Castle]!
The [03Oda Army] has launched a full-scale assault! The [03Oda Army]'s morale is rising!
The [03allied forces]' fire attack has set the southern end of the [01enemy naval fleet] aflame!
Defeat [01Shigenari Kimura] and rescue [03%s]!
Defeat [01Masanori Fukushima] and rescue [03%s]!
Defeat [01Matabei Gotō] and rescue [03%s]!
Liu Shan's
The [03fire attack] has eliminated the [01enemy officers] within the garrison!
The [03Coalition Army] has secured ground for the [03allied rifle unit] to deploy!
[01Jian Yong] and [01Wang Ping] have been found!
Eliminate the [01enemy forces] within [02Niu Zhu Garrison]!
[03%s]'s sorcery has stopped [01Nene's whirlwinds]!
[03Zhang Liang]'s sorcery has conjured up [03phantoms of mighty warriors]!
[03%s] has proven [03Meng Huo]'s innocence!
[03Okuni] has been defeated! [03Okuni]'s journey to gather donations has failed!
[04Zhu Rong] has a renewed respect for [03Meng Huo]'s might!
[01Zhang Fei] appears willing to lend his strength!
Hahaha... Trample those Oda maggots into the dirt!
Officers of the Three Kingdoms, gathered under a noble house! I expect you to fight valiantly!
Hmm, so Lord Dong Zhuo is a man of valor as well...
Hmph! What did you take me for?
Follow me, and together we'll enjoy my grand paradise!
Let us end this battle quickly, so we can all enjoy a game of kemari!
Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Sun Quan... I'll crush the lot of you!
Let them hear it... the fierce sound of rebellion.
To take Fan Castle, destroy the sluice gate and flood it!
The heart of kemari is harmony... It suits you perfectly, Lord Liu Bei!
I am the One-Eyed Dragon! A tiger's claws don't even tickle!
Fine by me... I'll snap that tiger's fangs myself.
They've brought out a troublesome toy... Is Taishi Ci here?
Such an ordinary plan... Taishi Ci, go and break that thing for me.
The castle gates seem to be in danger. I shall send General Taishi Ci.
We must stop the Uesugi army... Strengthen the defense of the center!
They're planning a sneak attack... So they'll appear over there next?
As if I could fail to read a mortal's plan... Next will come a sneak attack.
The enemy has vanished? Most likely a sneak attack...
Let's head them off before they can strike our main camp.
Blast, we were too late!
I read their move correctly, but it seems we were too late.
You thwart my strategy? Impressive...
With this number of enemies, we can't afford to wait for much longer.
Let us use a fire attack to deliver victory to our army...
Let's set an ambush for the enemies who come fleeing from the ships.
Sakon, is that the best your wits and courage can do?
Nobody told me you'd be here.
I thought you'd be more fun than that, Sima Yi.
Silence! If not for you, my victory would have been total!
Mere mortals trying to defeat me was reckless from the start.
Insufferable mystic! This battle isn't over until it's over!
The [01Dong Zhuo Army] has fled in fear of [03%s]'s might!
[03%s] has been unable to prove their might!
Eliminate the [01rifle unit] within one minute to prove your might to [01Masamune Date]!
[04Liu Bei] is on the move!
We've got a huge army here! Get past us if you can!
W-whoa! Somebody help me!
Ha! All bark and no bite, just like I thought!
Honestly! Time to punish all you bullies at once!
The likes of you will never get past my rifle unit!
The Tokugawa army is being pushed back by the enemy's fierce assault!
Please, hurry to their aid!
Anyone who lays a hand on Lord Yoshitsune gets a pounding from the great Benkei!@SC44_102
Ah, Benkei! You came at just the right time!
Well done, Tadakatsu! I owe you my life.
My thanks to the three of you for your aid!
Ah, Lord Yuan Shao! Won't you stay for a cup of tea?
Such composure. You truly have the bearing of a noble clan.
Dian Wei! Just seeing your face has perked me right up!
Thanks! You really saved me there!
I will protect Lord Liu Chan... even if it costs me my life.
We will overcome the strategies of these great tacticians with our combined strength!
So it's a fire attack! That garrison must be the key.
The great Zhou Yu's brilliant plan... It would be a shame not to use it!
You can't even see through such a simple plan? How disappointing.
Open the gates and assault the enemy's main camp!
Ah, the famous Takeda Cavalry!
Deploy the rifle unit to the central garrison!
I would expect nothing less from Lord Shingen. A fearsome strategy.
But how about this? Rifle unit, forward!
Report! Suspicious activity has been detected in Niu Zhu Garrison!
Position the ambush troops! We'll lie in wait for them instead!
You're quite the handful. Are you trying to make trouble for me?
But I wanted to see how cool you look in battle, my darling!
Hahahaha... You call yourself a great strategist with such a childish plan?
Perhaps you should save your laughter until after you've won?
Your clumsy plan may fool mortals, but it won't fool me, Zhuge Liang.
Then let me see what you are capable of, Master Taigong.
Sorry, but it's dangerous there. Could you get out of the way?
I-I cannot do that! I will follow my path to the end!
All the brilliant stratagems we witnessed in battle against these great tacticians...
Let us make them our own, and put them to use in the righteous battles to come!
Don't let the enemy out! Keep them trapped inside!
It seems my might is not enough to win this...
What a magnificent warrior... I am truly impressed!
Boast of your might all you like, you are only human. I cannot possibly lose!
Anyone who comes for Orochi will fall to Masamune Date!
What do you expect from Orochi, the very source of this calamity?
Well, boy? Are you ready to join forces with me yet?
Silence! Today I will send you back to the underworld!
[01Huang Zu] has had his momentum stopped by [03%s], and is flummoxed!
Is it my destiny... to perish here?
Even your profile is lovely as you flee... A beauty always makes a pretty picture.
I am in a hurry... Please, let me pass...
The enemy may be lying in wait.
Please escort him to safety.
So it's come to this after all... How futile.
You tried to harm my beautiful Oichi! It is you who will be eliminated!
How rude! You're in for some punishment!
Sounds like it's going to be a pretty flimsy history.
I'd rather not see my name recorded in a history with no basis in fact.
To struggle against destiny... is futile...
Forgive me, I could not hold the castle...
The [03allied commander] is struggling under a sneak attack by the [01enemy]!
Reporting! Our commander has come under a sneak attack!
The castle is surrounded. We cannot move rashly.
Break the siege on the castle first, then go to the commander's aid.
How dare you stand before a noble! Know your place!
Then show me your treasure, and I'll judge just how noble you are!
Nobility has its perks! Nice weapon! I'll be taking that!
What's this, Himiko? Don't tell me you've found honor too?
Everyone keeps goin' on about honor... What is it, anyway?
Ook! Master! What are you doing in a place like this?
It's for your sake, Wukong. I would follow you anywhere.
Trying to save the peasants? Meddling fools.
Ha... Be tossed about by the winds of chaos.
Thanks! I can dance so much more beautifully with a breeze!
Neither demon nor human... You poor creature...
I am well versed in commanding the wind.
We'll fight too, and be of use to you all!
You're the one who's to be pitied.
Well, hand over that sword and I'll let it slide.
They're not pitiful! Everybody's just tryin' their hardest to live!
Gahahahaha... You certainly are a stubborn lot!
The [03%s unit] ambushes the [01Orochi Army]! The [01Orochi Army]'s morale is falling!
The enemy seems to be gathering in the center...
Let's call in reinforcements and take the enemy out all at once.
We can't call in reinforcements now...
We'll just have to face them on our own somehow.
Master! I-I'm just a double! The real one's over there!
Wukong, you can't fool my eyes! Now, shall we go home?
Hey, what's with that look...? You're scaring me!
I have seen through your doubles...
Benkei, I reckon you'd be better off on our side.
Heh! Whichever side I'm on is the side that wins!
You're the one person I ain't gonna lose to!
Oh yeah? You're shorter than me!
Anyone who gets in Da Ji's way has me to deal with!
There, there, good girl! But it's time you went home now.
The only thing intense around here is your mouth.
Climb to the altar and assist me with my sorcery!
Then a miracle from the heavens shall dispel the whirlwinds!
My sorcery will fail like this... Clear the enemy from the altar!
O heavens, grant me strength! Winds, be still!
You look nimble, but can you dodge my attacks?
Hey, mister, you can do some pretty neat tricks, huh?
M-mister...?
What shame is there in losing to a noble such as I?
Me too! If I lose, my missus'll give me an earful!
What's up, monkey boy? You're awfully desperate today.
Achieve a Combo of 100 to show your might on the battlefield!
Terrified by [03%s]'s might, the [01enemy reinforcements] have stopped coming!
I will call in the naval forces. Someone escort me!
Such strength! There's no way we can beat them!
Reporting! There seem to be suspicious soldiers in the mist!
Whoa, that's one long sword! Let me have a look at it!
Master! You didn't have to chase me all the way out here!
Wherever you go, you can't escape me.
Lady Da Ji... We have no chance of winning now...
You're just small fry! Don't get ideas about turning on me!
Lady Da Ji, why don't you just surrender?
Don't be stupid, you pig.
Call in [03allied reinforcements], and impress [01Cao Cao] and the others!
[03%s] has appeared!
[01Cao Cao] is impressed with [03%s]'s skill!
[01Mitsuhide Akechi] is impressed with [03%s]'s skill!
[03Guan Xing] has appeared! Impressed, he wishes to join [03%s] in battle!
[03Guan Suo] has appeared! Impressed, he wishes to join [03%s] in battle!
[03Xing Cai] has appeared! Impressed, she wishes to join [03Zhao Yun] in battle!
[01Guan Yu] is impressed with [03%s]'s skill!
Lord Zhao Yun is as strong as ever... Please, let me fight beside you.
My thanks! You have become a fine officer, Xing Cai.
The northern defenses are weak... A surprise attack is our best move.
We'll swing north along the side road and launch a surprise attack on Ueda Castle!
Stay away from the enemy's main force! They'll catch on to our plan!
Reporting! We've found a floodgate! The enemy is there too!
Could they be planning to flood us out...?
Admirable, Guan Ping. But your plan is far too obvious...
So even the great thief is dazzled by the splendor of a noble house?
A strategy even Zhuge Liang approves of? That's quite a feather in my cap.
Goddess of fire, you've already set my heart ablaze.
What an outfit! Argh, I mustn't look!
Rescue the imprisoned [04allied officers]!
[04Liu Bei] has been rescued!
Destroy the [01Orochi Army]!
Alliance formed with the [04Coalition Army]!
Lord Liu Bei, I'm coming to your aid!
H-hey, Da Qiao! Stop it!
How dare my little sister be cuter than me! Take this!
My sister would never be that mean. You're a fake!
Thanks, you saved me! I'll pay you back, I promise!
Why settle for a cold statue when there's a handsome man of flesh and blood right here?
Envious of those in love? You're just lonely!
A trite plot and actors unequal to their roles. This play is unbearable to watch.
So desperate... I almost feel sorry for you...
Defeat [01Magoichi Saika]!
Shimazu siding with Date... Think you can win that gamble?
In war and in gambling, you never know until it's over.
So, the girl from Shu. You're every bit as fierce as Tachibana.
Then I'll live up to those words by defeating you.
Xiao Qiao, you're with the enemy?
Oh, it's my sister! Okay, I'm not gonna lose!
It's dangerous here, little lady. Why don't you run along home?
Hmph! For your information, I'm a married woman!
Yukimura, stand aside! Have we not fought side by side?
Even you, Lord Yuan Shao, I cannot let pass. Prepare yourself!
Yukimura! Siding with Masamune? I don't like it one bit!
Under honor, people can come to understand each other... That is what I believe.
Defeat the [01enemy defense captains] and secure [03%s]'s escape route!
[03%s] is retreating to the [03allied main camp]!
Protect [03%s] from attack by [01enemy forces]!
Eliminate the [01enemy forces] within the main camp and ensure [03%s]'s safety!
[03%s] has successfully retreated!
[03%s] has been isolated!
The enemy is closing in on our main camp!
Please make defending our main camp your priority for now!
Reporting! If we defeat the enemy defense captains, the boats should return!
Ah, the way to the main camp is open... I am in your debt!
What are you doing, Ieyasu? I thought you were done for!
I am ashamed. I owe you my life, Lord Sun Ce.
L-Lord Nobunaga! To think that you would come to my rescue...
Master Taigong, forgive me for causing you such trouble.
A clumsy fight, and so unlike the ever-composed General Ieyasu.
You came to my aid in my hour of need. I cannot thank you enough...
I'm glad I made it in time! Be careful from now on, okay?
Hey, big guy! Hand that weapon over to me!
It's for Ieyasu's sake... I won't back down, even against Lu Bu!
[01Fan Chou] has engaged [03%s] in combat!
[03%s] has routed [01Fan Chou]!
Hmph... Have you come here to preach at me?
I'm not moving! Someone get rid of him!
W-wait, I was only joking! What are you all doing? Advance!
I am King of Nanman! Don't you underestimate me!
Turning the tables from a losing position... I'll show you the true thrill of war!
Hehehe... I've only just started rampaging!
You look like you want to play kemari. Am I right?
You're in my way. Move.
[01Sun Ce] has noticed [03%s] and the others!
[01Sun Ce] is restraining himself from going after [03%s] and the others!
[01Sun Ce] can't hold back any longer, and is challenging [03%s] and the others!
[03%s]'s taunt has succeeded!
[03%s] is moving toward the southern cannon fortress to lure [01Huang Zhong] out!
Escort [03%s] to the southern cannon fortress!
[03Xiahou Ba] has arrived at the southern cannon fortress!
[03Xiahou Ba] has been defeated!
[01Huang Zhong] is enraged by [03%s]'s taunt!
Hmm, it seems hot-blooded officers are guarding the cannons.
If we can lure them out, we may yet find a chance of victory...
Hey, looks like somebody's really cuttin' it up out there!
Oh, I can't help it! Hey, you! Fight me!
What, done already? Lame...
Sun Ce, you fall for these things far too easily...
Lord Sun Ce... Please don't do anything reckless...
Lord Sun Ce... It's in his nature, but he fights so recklessly...
Hey, grandad! Come on out of there!
Huang Zhong reacted exactly as I expected...
Well, well. He's not hard to read, is he?
Huang Zhong... I'm glad he's not on our side.
Now's our chance! Our target is the Date main camp. Open fire with all cannons!
Just as I thought, they're attacking from the undermanned south side...
I'd love to lure them in and crush them all at once.
Now! Crush those silly little enemies!
Oh, it failed... What a shame.
Hmm, some suspicious-looking unit has shown up.
They might be up to something...? Tighten the defenses everywhere!
So they're after the water gate after all. It's so obvious it's funny!
Reporting! Enemy reinforcements appear to be arriving through that base!
If we take that base, we should be able to stop the enemy reinforcements!
I won't let the demons have their way with this world!
Such a noisy one... Begone.
Warrior monk, you side with Da Ji! In the name of honor, I will punish you!
I've got no reason to be punished by the likes of you! Get lost!
So you've come to spread chaos again, have you?
It is my karma... Hehe.
Ah, here comes the fall guy. Let's make short work of him.
Hehehe... I'm not the fall guy today!
What a lovely dance. Shame this is a battlefield.
Being called lovely... It's kind of embarrassing.
I hear the captive Yoshikage Asakura hails from a distinguished house!
I, Yuan Shao, will not allow a noble house to perish!
An ambush... As expected of Lu Xun. But this is all according to plan.
Lord Nagamasa... more gallant than ever...
